name: Shatila Bakery
summary: Founded in 1979 by Riad Shatila, Shatila Bakery is a family-run institution specializing in authentic Mediterranean pastries including baklawa made with Turkish pistachios, Brazilian cashews, and California walnuts in thin filo dough. The Dearborn flagship stays open late seven days a week, serving a broad range of Lebanese sweets. Custom cakes are available via a dedicated email contact. The bakery ships nationally and operates additional locations in Dearborn Heights and West Bloomfield.
customCakeProcess: Custom cake inquiries handled via shatilacakes@gmail.com
